grammar.pattern: 为 + 受益者 + 动作
grammar.explanation: 为朋友打印 identifies the beneficiary. 给朋友两页材料 identifies the recipient in a transfer; the patterns can describe different aspects of the same event. 为 wèi here is not wéi in 成为. A beneficiary phrase does not prove that permission has been obtained. Ask first when the action affects another person’s records.

examples.py: wǒ wèi péng you dǎ yìn cái liào .
examples.en: I print materials for my friend.

examples.zh: 先为她问清楚，再给她答复。
examples.py: xiān wèi tā wèn qīng chǔ , zài gěi tā dá fù .
examples.en: First clarify for her, then give her a reply.

examples.py: wǒ bù néng tì tā tóng yì .
examples.en: I cannot agree on her behalf.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我为她同意参加，所以她一定愿意。
commonMistakes.right: 先取得她的同意，再帮她报名。
commonMistakes.why: An action for someone is not evidence of their consent.

grammar.pattern: 有 + 意思 / 用 / 时间等：评价或条件
grammar.purpose: Read 有 in a stated evaluation
grammar.explanation: 这份材料有用 evaluates usefulness, rather than saying the material owns a physical object called 用. 很有意思 evaluates interest. 我有时间 remains an availability statement. Identify the whole phrase; possession and evaluation are separate uses, and usefulness depends on the stated task.

examples.py: zhè liǎng yè cái liào hěn yǒu yòng .
zhè gè lì zi hěn yǒu yì si .
wǒ xià wǔ yǒu shí jiān bāng nǐ .
examples.en: I have time to help you this afternoon.

commonMistakes.wrong: 这材料是有用的东西有。
commonMistakes.why: Use 有用 as the evaluation predicate.

lines.zh: 下午能帮我打印两页材料吗？
lines.py: xià wǔ néng bāng wǒ dǎ yìn liǎng yè cái liào ma ?
lines.en: Could you print two pages for me this afternoon?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 可以，哪两页？
lines.py: kě yǐ , nǎ liǎng yè ?
lines.en: Sure. Which pages?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 第二页和第三页。我发给你。
lines.py: dì èr yè hé dì sān yè . wǒ fā gěi nǐ .
lines.en: Pages two and three. I'll send them.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。我两点去办公室，那时候开门。
lines.py: hǎo . wǒ liǎng diǎn qù bàn gōng shì , nà shí hòu kāi mén .
lines.en: Okay. I'll go to the office at two, when it opens.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 里面的计算机能用吗？
lines.py: lǐ miàn de jì suàn jī néng yòng ma ?
lines.en: Can we use the computer inside?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 能，打印机也能用。拿到以后我给你送过来。
lines.py: néng , dǎ yìn jī yě néng yòng . ná dào yǐ hòu wǒ gěi nǐ sòng guò lái .
lines.en: Yes, and the printer. I'll bring the pages to you afterwards.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 谢谢！我在教室，三点才下课。
lines.py: xiè xiè ! wǒ zài jiào shì , sān diǎn cái xià kè .
lines.en: Thanks! I'm in class until three.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那三点教室门口见。
lines.py: nà sān diǎn jiào shì mén kǒu jiàn .
lines.en: Then let's meet outside the classroom at three.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 还有星期六那个活动，你去吗？
lines.py: hái yǒu xīng qī liù nà gè huó dòng , nǐ qù ma ?
lines.en: Are you going to that event on Saturday too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我想去，不过上午有事。活动几点开始？
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng qù , bù guò shàng wǔ yǒu shì . huó dòng jǐ diǎn kāi shǐ ?
lines.en: I'd like to, but I'm busy in the morning. What time does it start?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 下午两点。先别报名，我问问还有没有位子。
lines.py: xià wǔ liǎng diǎn . xiān bié bào míng , wǒ wèn wèn hái yǒu méi yǒu wèi zi .
lines.en: Two in the afternoon. Don't sign up yet; I'll ask if there are places left.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，你问到了再告诉我。
lines.py: hǎo , nǐ wèn dào le zài gào sù wǒ .
lines.en: Okay. Let me know when you hear back.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A careful volunteer note
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 今天陈宇请我帮忙打印材料，他只要第二页和第三页。我先把文件存好，下午两点去办公室。
lines.py: jīn tiān chén yǔ qǐng wǒ bāng máng dǎ yìn cái liào , tā zhǐ yào dì èr yè hé dì sān yè . wǒ xiān bǎ wén jiàn cún hǎo , xià wǔ liǎng diǎn qù bàn gōng shì .
lines.en: Chen Yu asked me to print some material today, just pages two and three. I saved the file and went to the office at two.

lines.zh: 办公室刚开门，教师正在里面整理东西。我问能不能用计算机，她指给我看，还告诉我纸放在哪里。
lines.py: bàn gōng shì gāng kāi mén , jiào shī zhèng zài lǐ miàn zhěng lǐ dōng xi . wǒ wèn néng bù néng yòng jì suàn jī , tā zhǐ gěi wǒ kàn , hái gào sù wǒ zhǐ fàng zài nǎ lǐ .
lines.en: The office had just opened. A teacher was tidying up inside. I asked to use the computer; she showed me it and where the paper was.

lines.zh: 我打印完检查了一下，页数对了，字也很清楚。陈宇还在上课，我没有进去打断他，先在校园里走了一会儿。
lines.py: wǒ dǎ yìn wán jiǎn chá le yī xià , yè shù duì le , zì yě hěn qīng chǔ . chén yǔ hái zài shàng kè , wǒ méi yǒu jìn qù dǎ duàn tā , xiān zài xiào yuán lǐ zǒu le yī huì er .
lines.en: After printing I checked: the pages were right and the text clear. Chen Yu was still in class, so I walked around campus rather than interrupt him.

lines.zh: 三点我们在教室门口见面。他拿到材料，打开看了看，说正好可以用，谢谢我跑一趟。
lines.py: sān diǎn wǒ men zài jiào shì mén kǒu jiàn miàn . tā ná dào cái liào , dǎ kāi kàn le kàn , shuō zhèng hǎo kě yǐ yòng , xiè xiè wǒ pǎo yī tàng .
lines.en: We met outside the classroom at three. He looked through the pages and said they were just what he needed. He thanked me for the trip.

lines.zh: 他还问了星期六的活动，工作人员说还有位子。活动下午两点开始，我上午的事情来得及做完，就说一起去吧。
lines.py: tā hái wèn le xīng qī liù de huó dòng , gōng zuò rén yuán shuō hái yǒu wèi zi . huó dòng xià wǔ liǎng diǎn kāi shǐ , wǒ shàng wǔ de shì qíng lái de jí zuò wán , jiù shuō yì qǐ qù ba .
lines.en: He'd asked about Saturday's event too; the staff said there were places left. It started at two, leaving me time to finish my morning plans, so I said let's go together.

lines.zh: 回家路上，他把报名的消息发来。我看见两个人的名字都在，回复他说周六见，材料也别忘了带。
lines.py: huí jiā lù shàng , tā bǎ bào míng de xiāo xī fā lái . wǒ kàn jiàn liǎng gè rén de míng zi dōu zài , huí fù tā shuō zhōu liù jiàn , cái liào yě bié wàng le dài .
lines.en: On my way home he sent the registration message. Both our names were there. I replied: see you Saturday, and don't forget the materials.

choices: They meet at three and decide to attend Saturday’s event
They enter the class to interrupt
The printer fails and the pages are lost
questions.answer: They meet at three and decide to attend Saturday’s event

choices: The morning plans can finish in time
questions.answer: The morning plans can finish in time

lines.en: We cheered her on as she ran towards us.

lines.zh: 我求他再讲一个故事。
lines.py: wǒ qiú tā zài jiǎng yī gè gù shì .
lines.en: I begged him to tell another story.

lines.zh: 求你了，别再逗我笑了。
lines.py: qiú nǐ le , bié zài dòu wǒ xiào le .
lines.en: Please, stop making me laugh.

lines.zh: 下午去取打印好的材料。
lines.py: xià wǔ qù qǔ dǎ yìn hǎo de cái liào .
lines.en: Collect the printed materials in the afternoon.

lines.zh: 我去车站取票，你在门口等我。
lines.py: wǒ qù chē zhàn qǔ piào , nǐ zài mén kǒu děng wǒ .
lines.en: I'll collect the tickets at the station. Wait at the entrance.

lines.zh: 先取得她的同意，再帮她报名。
lines.py: xiān qǔ dé tā de tóng yì , zài bāng tā bào míng .
lines.en: Obtain her consent before signing her up.

lines.zh: 这次比赛，他取得了第一名。
lines.py: zhè cì bǐ sài , tā qǔ dé le dì yī míng .
lines.en: He came first in this competition.

lines.zh: 拿到材料以后，检查页数。
lines.py: ná dào cái liào yǐ hòu , jiǎn chá yè shù .
lines.en: Once you get the materials, check the number of pages.

lines.zh: 我拿到新书就给你看。
lines.py: wǒ ná dào xīn shū jiù gěi nǐ kàn .
lines.en: I'll show you the new book as soon as I get it.

lines.zh: 我想向老师借一本书。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng xiàng lǎo shī jiè yī běn shū .
lines.en: I would like to borrow a book from the teacher.

lines.zh: 你的笔能借我一下吗？
lines.py: nǐ de bǐ néng jiè wǒ yī xià ma ?
lines.en: Can I borrow your pen for a moment?

lines.zh: 只打印两页，不是整本书。
lines.py: zhǐ dǎ yìn liǎng yè , bù shì zhěng běn shū .
lines.en: Print only two pages, not the whole book.

lines.zh: 这张照片可以打印出来吗？
lines.py: zhè zhāng zhào piān kě yǐ dǎ yìn chū lái ma ?
lines.en: Can this photo be printed?

lines.zh: 计算机在办公室里。
lines.py: jì suàn jī zài bàn gōng shì lǐ .
lines.en: The computer is in the office.

lines.zh: 这台计算机用了五年了。
lines.py: zhè tái jì suàn jī yòng le wǔ nián le .
lines.en: This computer has been used for five years.

lines.zh: 先问办公室什么时候开门。
lines.py: xiān wèn bàn gōng shì shén me shí hou kāi mén .
lines.en: First ask when the office opens.

lines.zh: 她的办公室在二楼。
lines.py: tā de bàn gōng shì zài èr lóu .
lines.en: Her office is on the second floor.

lines.zh: 教师不是每天都在办公室。
lines.py: jiào shī bù shì měi tiān dōu zài bàn gōng shì .
lines.en: The teacher is not in the office every day.

lines.zh: 她是一位音乐教师。
lines.py: tā shì yī wèi yīn yuè jiào shī .
lines.en: She's a music teacher.

lines.zh: 教室里还有人在上课。
lines.py: jiào shì lǐ hái yǒu rén zài shàng kè .
lines.en: People are still having class in the classroom.

lines.zh: 教室里有三十张桌子。
lines.py: jiào shì lǐ yǒu sān shí zhāng zhuō zi .
lines.en: There are thirty desks in the classroom.

lines.zh: 这是教学用的材料。
lines.py: zhè shì jiào xué yòng de cái liào .
lines.en: These are teaching materials.

lines.zh: 这位老师有十年的教学经验。
lines.py: zhè wèi lǎo shī yǒu shí nián de jiào xué jīng yàn .
lines.en: This teacher has ten years of teaching experience.

lines.zh: 她在大学学教育。
lines.py: tā zài dà xué xué jiào yù .
lines.en: She studies education at university.

lines.zh: 他们在讨论音乐教育。
lines.py: tā men zài tǎo lùn yīn yuè jiào yù .
lines.en: They're discussing music education.

lines.zh: 请把要打印哪两页讲清楚。
lines.py: qǐng bǎ yào dǎ yìn nǎ liǎng yè jiǎng qīng chǔ .
lines.en: Please explain clearly which two pages to print.

lines.zh: 再讲一次吧，我刚才没听清。
lines.py: zài jiǎng yī cì ba , wǒ gāng cái méi tīng qīng .
lines.en: Say it again, please. I didn't hear clearly just now.

lines.zh: 老师讲话时，我先听完再问。
lines.py: lǎo shī jiǎng huà shí , wǒ xiān tīng wán zài wèn .
lines.en: When the teacher speaks, I listen to the end before asking.

lines.zh: 他讲话的时候有点紧张。
lines.py: tā jiǎng huà de shí hou yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng .
lines.en: He's a little nervous when speaking.

lines.zh: 家长正在校门口等孩子。
lines.py: jiā zhǎng zhèng zài xiào mén kǒu děng hái zi .
lines.en: Parents are waiting for their children at the school gate.

lines.zh: 家长会下午三点开始。
lines.py: jiā zhǎng huì xià wǔ sān diǎn kāi shǐ .
lines.en: The parent meeting starts at three in the afternoon.

lines.zh: 她在高中工作，不是这个大学。
lines.py: tā zài gāo zhōng gōng zuò , bù shì zhè gè dà xué .
lines.en: She works at a senior high school, not this university.

lines.zh: 高中毕业以后，她去了上海。
lines.py: gāo zhōng bì yè yǐ hòu , tā qù le shàng hǎi .
lines.en: After finishing high school she went to Shanghai.

lines.zh: 这是中小学教师的活动。
lines.py: zhè shì zhōng xiǎo xué jiào shī de huó dòng .
lines.en: This is an activity for primary and secondary teachers.

lines.zh: 附近的中小学今天都放假。
lines.py: fù jìn de zhōng xiǎo xué jīn tiān dōu fàng jià .
lines.en: The nearby primary and secondary schools are all on holiday today.

lines.zh: 校园里的路要先看地图。
lines.py: xiào yuán lǐ de lù yào xiān kàn dì tú .
lines.en: Check a map first for the roads on campus.

lines.zh: 春天的校园里有很多花。
lines.py: chūn tiān de xiào yuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō huā .
lines.en: There are lots of flowers on campus in spring.

lines.zh: 我们在校园里遇到了校长。
lines.py: wǒ men zài xiào yuán lǐ yù dào le xiào zhǎng .
lines.en: We met the principal on campus.

lines.zh: 校长在门口迎接新学生。
lines.py: xiào zhǎng zài mén kǒu yíng jiē xīn xué sheng .
lines.en: The principal is greeting new students at the entrance.

lines.zh: 他比我高一级。
lines.py: tā bǐ wǒ gāo yī jí .
lines.en: He is one grade above me.

lines.zh: 我妹妹今年上三年级。
lines.py: wǒ mèi mei jīn nián shàng sān nián jí .
lines.en: My younger sister is in third grade this year.

audio.zh: 还有星期六那个活动，你去吗？
audio.py: hái yǒu xīng qī liù nà gè huó dòng , nǐ qù ma ?
audio.en: Are you going to that event on Saturday too?

tasks.statement: They are talking about an event on Saturday.

audio.py: sān diǎn wǒ men zài jiào shì mén kǒu jiàn miàn . tā ná dào cái liào , dǎ kāi kàn le kàn , shuō zhèng hǎo kě yǐ yòng , xiè xiè wǒ pǎo yī tàng .
audio.en: We met outside the classroom at three. He looked through the pages and said they were just what he needed. He thanked me for the trip.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 二28, 二55. Native check: 求帮助 collocation, 为 beneficiary versus 给 recipient, 有用 evaluation, teacher/school terminology, consent and the original printer scene. No legal representation or automatic registration is implied. Planned retrieval 二22 / 二23: 往东走，路口再向左转。, 看着北边，不是已经往北走。, 出口在右边，别去左边。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Targeted HSK 2 naturalness review: natural 点了炒鸡蛋和一盘青菜 replaces generic dish wording, with precise passage glosses and aligned English; restaurant choice with a previous twenty-minute wait versus ten minutes today; two red scarves with different shoes, blue layer packed; printing only pages two/three at two and handing them over at three, Saturday event at two; activity-room discussion with a normal four-o’clock chime and Saturday three meeting. Removed assessment, identity and consent lectures inside friendly speech. All existing word/task IDs preserved. First examples retained where suitable, specific awkward examples fixed; every word also has an independently authored second context. Abstract education, behaviour and action vocabulary stays in separate examples rather than forced conversation. False statements checked against their own audio. Native flags: 为 beneficiary register, 取得成绩/同意 versus 拿到, educational 教师/教育/教学/中小学/年级 terms, 求 playful plea, 满意/不满 and 好处/坏处, adjective 色 forms, 站住 request strength, formal 受到/行动/行为 and colloquial 挺好. Native review pending. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
